claim_ceiling: Truth in exact complete finite structures for supported typed formulas; no world-truth, universal theorem, source fidelity or admission claim.

criterion_results.complete_models: Nonempty sorted domains, exact complete interpretations, total functions; missing interpretation is malformed rather than false.
criterion_results.execution_states: Cancellation, resource limits, malformed and unsupported inputs emit no truth value.
criterion_results.hand_controls: 18 tests including 20 Boolean truth comparisons, four quantified graph cases, alias/subtype/properness/overlap and typed decoder correspondence.
criterion_results.independent_denotation: Mathematical structures, term denotation and satisfaction specified without defining semantics as checker acceptance.
criterion_results.query_separation: T, populations and Q remain separate; premise-failing and population-vacuous structures do not receive target support.

limitations: Finite model evaluation alone cannot establish unrestricted entailment or logical absence.
No source-owner fidelity or full-definition translation acceptance.
Mutual dependency meaning and least-fixed-point semantics are separate from ordinary FOL satisfaction.
review_disposition.result: Accepted for controlled model-local evaluation and later provider integration.

task_result: PASS for independent static denotation specification and controlled finite satisfaction implementation
